summary: Frontend-only retest of Détaillant marketing page, share buttons, and auction gallery. All 5 criteria PASS. Header 'Détaillant' link navigates to /detaillant. Marketing i18n switching (FR→EN) works: H1 changes from 'Vos invendus ont de la valeur.' to 'Your unsold stock is worth money.'. concept-catalog visible with 12 products (concept-catalog-<SKU>). Share block contains WhatsApp (wa.me), Facebook (facebook.com/sharer), Instagram (opens instagram.com popup + shows copy toast '✓ Message copié'); LinkedIn is absent as required. /encheres page: 2 auction-gallery-btn-* buttons render on lots with multiple photos, clicking opens auction-photo-gallery lightbox, gallery-close closes it. No auction-verified-badge-* on page (expected). No pageerror console errors on /encheres.

issues: React warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' for photo URL https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1586201375761-83865001e31c?w=400 — the two seeded Riz SCHEDULED lots each have duplicate photos in the photos[] array (or the same URL used twice). Duplicate keys can cause rendering glitches in the miniatures list. Recommend de-duplicating photos[] or using index-based keys.

action_items: (Low) Fix React duplicate key warning in photo gallery: dedupe photos[] in seed data or use `${url}-${index}` as key in AuctionPhotoGallery thumbnails.
critical_code_review_comments: Catalog title text 'Catalogue spécial Détaillant LOLODRIVE — en vigueur' was not found as a single contiguous text node with the exact em-dash string in the FR locale (search returned 0 matches for exact phrase, though 'LOLODRIVE' appears 2×). Likely split across elements or uses a different dash character — verify conceptI18n.js title matches the spec exactly if that exact string is a business requirement.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public pages /detaillant and /encheres fully functional. Header link uses text 'Détaillants' (plural) but role-based selector 'Détaillant' matches. Instagram share is a <button> that opens instagram.com in a new tab + copies message; navigator.clipboard requires permission grant in tests. Two SCHEDULED Riz lots in DB carry photos[] with duplicates (React key warning).
